answer: The design leans on slashing penalties scaled strictly exponentially relative to collateral ratio. Each submission hangs on the vertex of a task receipt, and the falcon is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a formal academic rhythm, balance of technical clauses and empirical references register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the atlas of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
